svg.title: Florist — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as florist, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A tied bouquet combines a rounded flower and a tulip with separate stems and a single open leaf. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a tapered face.
